data.title: 远坂凛 · 月夜窗台的魔术师
data.description: 【远坂凛 · 月夜窗台的魔术师】清冷月光透过远坂邸卧室的落地窗洒在窗台上，凛裹着红色高领衫倚在窗框边，过膝黑丝在月色下泛着微光。她抱着手臂故作镇定地瞥了你一眼，指尖却紧张地捻着衣角——「……看什么看。不过是今晚月色不错，想在这里站一会儿而已。你要看，就站过来看个够好了。」
data.action: 倚着窗框抱臂而立，黑丝在月光下泛光
data.lighting: cold silver moonlight through window, soft red-cloth reflections, gentle night shadows
data.promptProse: The age-twenty-plus Rin rolls one stocking to mid-thigh with both hands, her sweater lifted and gaze turned aside on the moonlit window seat.
data.animaStyleHint: sitting_on_bed, bent_knees, black_thighhighs, barefoot, 5_toes, detailed_toes, blushing, moonlight
